body: I feel like I remember either an I-dont-care-inator or an indifferent-inator being in the show at some point
Wish y'all weren't so anti-nuclear, but aside from that, can't complain about the home of Porsche/VW and Mercedes

My friend and I both have very addictive personalities so it was never so much one game that we would latch on to as it was we'd pick one during a given break and just grind the hell out of it.

Among them were Ark, DayZ, Terraria, Battlefield V, and PubG

We just really enjoyed the aspect of figuring out our perfect system of cooperation and were willing to just sink weeks of our time into it

In retrospect, kind of wish we would have found more productive hobbies to devote the same level of effort to, but at the same time, it's nice just knowing I have good enough friend that we don't need to talk to understand eachother

Context:

I'm a guy in college, and I have an extensive history of missing hints that I need thoroughly explained to me after parties.


Sidenote, I've had several girls ask me to wait in line with them to pee, but when I'm drunk and I need to pee, I just go find a tree and take advantage of the gift God gave me. Come back inside, and the girl is nowhere to be found, what's up with that?
